docs.text: UNDER CONSTRUCTION - EM CONSTRUÇÃO - EN CONSTRUCCIÓN This page will be an instance of LSDB.io service hosted at LIneA 's datacenter. LSDB.io is a service to efficiently store and access large astronomical datasets, developed by the LSST Interdiciplinary Network for Collaboration and Computing ( LINCC ). LIneA (Laboratório Interinstitucional de e-Astronomia) is a Brazilian national laboratory for e-Astronomy with the mission to provide infrastructure and support for data-intensive astronomy in Brazil.
